Package com.hkust.marketplace.services

Class AdminListingService

java.lang.Object
com.hkust.marketplace.services.AdminListingService
public class AdminListingService extends Object
Control class for Task 3.7 Manage Marketplace Listings and Task 3.2 Listing Review. Every method starts with the admin role check. This class does not use the ui layer.

    • removeListing

      public void removeListing(String listingId, String reason)
      Removes a listing (Task 3.7 step 5.5.4): status Removed, all open offers declined, seller notified with the reason. Cannot be used on listings already Sold, Given or Removed.
      Throws:
      ServiceException - if the reason is blank (A1), the listing does not exist, or it is already Sold, Given or Removed

    • editListing

      public void editListing(String listingId, String title, String description, Category category, ItemCondition condition, MeetupLocation meetupLocation, Double price, Duration duration, List<String> photoIds)
      Edits a listing (Task 3.7 step 5.4): title, description, category, condition, meet-up location, price (sale listings only), lending duration (lend listings only) and photos. The status never changes (Special Requirement 2). The action is recorded and the seller is notified. The seller's account may have been deleted; in that case the notification is skipped silently and the edit is still saved.
      Parameters:
      condition - the item's condition; required, as when adding (Task 3.7 "Edit any listing details"; assumptions register 94)
      price - new price for a sale listing, or null to leave it unchanged
      duration - new lending duration for a lend listing, or null to leave it unchanged
      photoIds - new photo ids (at most 6), or null to keep the current photos
      Throws:
      ServiceException - if a required field is missing or invalid (A1), the listing does not exist, or a price or duration is given for the wrong listing type

    • addListing

      public void addListing(String sellerUsername, ListingType type, String title, String description, Category category, ItemCondition condition, MeetupLocation meetupLocation, Double price, Duration duration, List<String> photoIds)
      Adds a listing on behalf of a seller (Task 3.7 step 5.6.4): creates the listing with status Live (approved immediately), records the action and notifies the seller.
      Parameters:
      price - required for SELL; must be null for LEND and GIVEAWAY
      duration - required for LEND; must be null for SELL and GIVEAWAY
      photoIds - optional, at most 6; null means no photos
      Throws:
      ServiceException - if any required field is missing or invalid (A1, A4)

    • findListings

      public List<Listing> findListings(ListingFilter filter)
      Lists the marketplace listings for the admin (Task 3.7 steps 2-4), newest posted first. Every chosen filter must match (AND); a null filter field means "no filter". A null filter is treated as no filter.
      Parameters:
      filter - the filter options, or null for no filter
      Returns:
      the matching listings; empty if none match (A2), never null
      Throws:
      ServiceException - if the start of the date range is after its end

    • getListingDetails

      public ListingDetails getListingDetails(String listingId)
      The details the admin sees when viewing one listing (Task 3.7 step 5.1): the listing, its seller's full name and the reports filed on it. Only the admin may see who reported (UC9 Special Requirement 4), which is why this is admin-only.
      Throws:
      ServiceException - if the listing does not exist
